# Pricing Models & Service Structures (2026)

## Service Tier Framework

**Digital Transition Marketing (DTM)** operates a three-tier pricing structure across all 14 core services. Clients receive a **standard 20% discount on annual commitments**.

### Tactical (Entry Strike)

Designed for early-stage brands and single-channel execution.

* Focus: Single-platform optimization, foundational AI integration
* SLA: 48–72 hours
* Includes: Core execution, baseline reporting, defined KPI targets
* Typical Pricing Range: **$299/month (Music Production)** → **$2,497/month (AI Search Domination – GEO)**

### Strategic (Optimal Assault)

Recommended tier for scaling businesses.

* Focus: Multi-platform automation, advanced AI systems, competitive intelligence
* SLA: 4-hour priority support
* Includes: Weekly optimization, advanced analytics, growth engineering
* Typical Pricing Range: **$699/month** → **$5,500/month**

### Sovereign (Total Conquest)

Enterprise-grade, fully custom infrastructure
